agencies_meta_desc: Intimate is a new platform for the Netherlands. We list your escorts, synced from your own website, and send clients straight to your number. Free, zero work.
agencies_hero_sub: Intimate is a new platform for the Netherlands. We pull your escorts straight from your own website, keep them in sync, and send clients straight to your number. You do nothing, and it costs nothing. Get on it before we launch.
agencies_demo_frame: A real taste of the platform: the exact speed, polish, and feel your agency gets. Tap any card; it opens just as a client sees it.
agencies_why_lead: We built Intimate for how clients actually find you now, not how they did a decade ago. Two shifts changed the game, and we built for both.
agencies_why_ai_body: Clients are asking ChatGPT where to go, not scrolling Google. AI recommends what it can actually read and trust, and we built Intimate from the ground up to be exactly that. Nothing in this industry is built for AI like this. When a client asks, your agency is what surfaces.
agencies_why_mobile_lead: And they ask on their phone.
agencies_why_mobile_body: Almost everyone asks AI on their phone, so the site it points them to has to be flawless there. Intimate is built like an app, not a desktop site squeezed small. A client who taps through books you, instead of bouncing.
agencies_sync_lead: The work of getting your escorts onto Intimate and keeping every profile current. Your whole roster goes live without any effort from you, and it stays up to date on its own, forever.
agencies_sync_site_body: Our AI reads your site and builds a profile for every escort on it. You upload nothing and type nothing.
agencies_sync_list_body: Already on other platforms? Send a plain Excel or CSV of your profiles and we import the whole roster for you.
agencies_sync_foot: From then on it stays current on its own. Change a photo or a price at your source, and Intimate follows within the day.
agencies_term_free_body: Your listing costs nothing, now and after launch.
agencies_term_sync_body: Give us your website once. Your Intimate profiles stay in step with it automatically. New faces, new photos, new prices appear on their own. You never log in.
agencies_term_account_body: You also get an agency account to manage your escorts whenever you want, though you'll rarely need it. We keep everything synced from whatever source you give us.
agencies_term_direct_body: Every client reaches you on your own number. We take nothing and stand between nothing.
agencies_term_leave_body: Change your mind and everything's offline within 24 hours. Any escort can remove her own profile herself, instantly.
agencies_catch_body: Your profiles are free of charge and always will be. We never bill you for them. The only time money comes up is if you choose to promote or highlight an escort for extra visibility, and that's entirely up to you.
agencies_catch_worst_body: Your profiles go up at zero cost, and every client Intimate sends you is free. The client who'd never have found you could be calling your number the day we launch.
agencies_catch_small: Pause or remove any profile, or all of them, anytime. One email, done within 24 hours. Every escort can also remove her own profile directly.

agencies_how_2_body: Every escort pulled straight from your own website. Your whole agency on Intimate, ready for you within 48 hours.
